data.narrative:
Crusoe Energy is a Series C artificial intelligence and software company that has raised over $3.0B to date and carries a last post-money valuation of $10.0B+. The valuation peer set comprises 9 private firms and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) in the same sector and stage cohort, including Figure AI, Scale AI, Skild AI, Wayve, and Physical Intelligence.

Two triangulation methods apply to this analysis. Stage-progression methodology, applying a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier from Series C to the next funding stage, implies a valuation of $17.0B. Peer-median analysis across six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $11.3B, with the peer set ranging from $3.2B (floor) to $39.0B (ceiling, Figure AI at Series C).

The two methods triangulate to a central range of $9.6B to $19.6B, with a median implied value of $14.2B. Crusoe's current $10.0B+ valuation sits at the lower bound of this range. Key uncertainties include calibration of the step-up multiplier to frontier-AI market conditions, which have proven volatile; wide dispersion in peer valuations ($3.2B to $39.0B) reflects heterogeneous risk profiles and commercial traction; and limited public comparables constrain cross-market validation.
